title: Exploring Semantic Table Search in Data Lakes
abstract: arXiv:2611.25691v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discovery of relevant datasets within data lakes remains a key challenge. Union and join search are effective techniques for discovering data when augmenting an existing table. In exploratory search, instead, keyword search is commonly adopted to find a relatively small set of highly relevant tables matching some search terms. In this context, semantic search is a new technique that exploits the presence of named entities in exemplar tuples used as queries and in target tables. Hence, keyword search and entity search are able to find a diverse set of tables. In this work, we propose \texttt{Thetis++}, which combines keyword and semantic table search to discover relevant tables that combine the semantic signal with the presence of exact keyword matches. Incorporating multiple paradigms and sources of information allow us to combine the best of multiple worlds. Therefore, we study many alternative techniques for combining rankings and eval

translated_title: 探索数据湖中的语义表格搜索
translated_abstract: 数据湖中相关数据集的发现仍然是一个关键挑战。联合搜索和连接搜索是在增强现有表格时发现数据的有效技术。而在探索性搜索中，关键词搜索通常被用来找到与某些搜索词相匹配的相对较小的高相关性表格集合。在这一背景下，语义搜索是一种新技术，它利用了作为查询的示例元组以及目标表格中命名实体的存在。因此，关键词搜索和实体搜索能够找到多样化的表格集合。在这项工作中，我们提出了 Thetis++，它将关键词搜索和语义表格搜索相结合，从而发现同时融合语义信号与精确关键词匹配的相关表格。整合多种范式和信息来源使我们能够结合不同方法的优势。因此，我们研究了多种用于组合排名的替代技术并进行评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了Thetis++系统，将关键词搜索与基于命名实体的语义搜索相结合，通过融合多种排名组合技术，更有效地在数据湖中发现相关表格数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Thetis++, a system that combines keyword search with entity-based semantic table search, leveraging multiple ranking combination techniques to more effectively discover relevant tables in data lakes.
